contract: libass 0.17.5's default configuration (ASS_HINTING_NONE): every face of one font file read from memory and loaded at 256 pixels (16384 in 26.6), after libass's GDI face metrics, with a REAL_DIM size request

outlines cases: the size metrics, libass's ascent and descent, HarfBuzz scale, emboldening strength, PostScript flag, underline and strikeout bands; the kerning at the size (FT_KERNING_DEFAULT) of every pair the kern table lists, nonzero values only; every glyph's FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING outline and advance, then that outline emboldened, slanted, and both; packets count outlines and bytes their points

advances cases: every glyph's FT_LOAD_DEFAULT advance at that size, which libass's HarfBuzz callbacks report; packets count advances; an advance the candidate cannot give ends its operation with an error, so the case fails

vertical cases: every glyph's linearVertAdvance and metrics.vertAdvance of the FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING load, with which libass draws a glyph of an @ font rotated, then metrics.vertAdvance of the FT_LOAD_DEFAULT load, which its HarfBuzz callbacks report as that glyph's advance; packets count glyphs; a default-load advance the candidate cannot give ends its operation with an error, so the case fails
the file is read before each timed and memory operation; the reference library is created once, outside it
